title: Create:Gunsmith Rebalance
description: a datapack that changes the recipes for the guns and ammo in Create:Gunsmithing to make it a more balanced experience
body:
Modified the recipes of the mod from Create:Gunsmithing to reduce the yield when it comes to bullets 

Bullets now only give 1 bullet every assembly round, no more 2,4,8 bullets being made! Now 1 brass sheet -> 1 Bullet

Grenages need more gunpoweder now!

Sulfur Lower Chance from magma block
